results.title: Tutaro
results.overview: Hungry for life, an egg yolk dives headlong into the world and gets lost in restless ecstasy.

results.title: Lice n' Shine
results.overview: A portrait of the everyday life of teenage girls in the sensitive ecosystem of a boarding school, where an entirely normal morning can quickly give way to chaos.

results.title: Kitzel
results.overview: Two fluffy creatures play together affectionately, but their frolics soon turn uncomfortable, as cuddling becomes a free-for-all and boundaries are crossed.

results.title: Heralds of the Monsoon
results.overview: Who has the elephant on their conscience? A Matti tree and a butterfly conduct an investigation together.

results.title: Glaube Sitte Heimat
results.overview: Helpless rituals and the smell of time gone stale: a portrait of a village that used to live from mining and where successful structural change seems unwilling to take hold.

results.title: Extinction Story
results.overview: Consisting of 4500 fragile natural artworks, the grandfather’s bird egg collection is an inheritance that reveals its collector’s 20th century biography: Josef Schreiber from Vorarlberg.

results.title: Awaken, My Children
results.overview: From through the thick smoke, the creation monster speaks to us, more animal than god. It regrets its biggest mistake of all: creating civilisation. Just what have we done?

results.title: Look, We're in Europe
results.overview: Building houses far from home: through their own mobile phone images, Bangladeshi construction workers in Kosovo offer a raw glimpse of life between precarious work and dreams of a bett er future.

results.title: B*tch
results.overview: Her womanhood was shaped by strict expectations: the lmmaker searches for belonging in the tension between her rural Slovakian roots, her sexuality and her creative callings.

results.title: Hotel Utopia
results.overview: In an abandoned hotel deep in the Bulgarian mountains, digital nomads search for a new home, investors are hoping for profit, and the last villager revels in days gone by – all driven by the longing for #happyland in a place shaped by a socialist past.

results.title: Molly & Wors: Die Geheim Van 'n Gelukkige Huwelik
results.original_title: Molly & Wors: Die Geheim Van 'n Gelukkige Huwelik
results.overview: The relationship between Molly and Wors is put to the test by unemployment, financial worries, and secrets. To top it off, Molly has booked an expensive boating holiday to save their marriage.

results.title: Kefi
results.overview: An alien-serving eldest, a dream-dating kidnapper, and a cheating youngest.  An ordinary day for three sisters unite after their father's death.

results.title: Saravah
results.overview: A man named Riku takes on a ghostwriting job for a celebrated screenwriter, bringing three former classmates together for the first time in ten years. Their love triangle may have ended long ago, but their lives remain hilariously tangled.

results.title: Silicon Saxony
results.overview: Europe’s largest chip factory is rising in Dresden – precisely where the heart of the GDR’s microelectronics industry once beat. Tracing the past and the  afterglow of a utopia.

results.title: Uncle Thuận
results.overview: The parents came to the GDR as contract workers and now run a restaurant in North Rhine-Westphalia. Their daughters ask questions about self-determination, belonging, and happiness.

results.title: The Class of 1990
results.overview: An East German student protest of the early 1990s, revisited by former acting students of Rostock’s “Ernst Busch” Academy.

results.title: Ten to Twenty Spoil Heaps
results.overview: The land is gone, but the slag heaps remain. A re ective exploration of soil and resources, labour and destruction, home and loss in an East German mining landscape.

results.title: The Teenage Vampire
results.overview: When a straightlaced young woman moves into a chic bungalow in the Hollywood Hills she imagines nothing but raging parties and romance in her future. But Sandra's new dream house quickly becomes a den of horrors after she discovers her landlords are ancient vampires and her first party guests are the victims of a bloody massacre. As the night grows more sinister and twisted, Sandra unearths the most terrifying secret of all.

results.title: The Nights
results.overview: La Pichi is a woman born on the fringes of Buenos Aires, gifted with an extraordinary talent for storytelling. Night after night, she transforms her own life into tales infused with humor, imagination, tenderness, and irreverence.
